turns.content:
Sana: didi mere manager ne ek aur meeting invent ki hai jo ek "no" ho sakti thi
Sana: din 4, dinner mein maggi. michelin star aani chahiye mujhe
Ruhi: lmaooo usko bol overtime ka bill bhejungi
Ruhi: aur maggi ab tere liye sabzi count hoti hai
Sana: haha haan. waise ghar pe sab kaisa hai? mumbai thoda zyada hi hai yaar. aaj phir akele dinner kiya, uske baad flat bahut khali sa lagta hai. ma ka phone bhi kam aata hai ab, shayad unko lagta hai main set ho gayi hoon.
Sana: pata nahi. neend bhi theek se nahi aa rahi. kuch hafte ho gaye aise hi.
Ruhi: arre abhi toh shift hui hai, time lagta hai! [meme bheja]
Ruhi: sab theek ho jayega, tu meri strong girl hai 💪
Sana: haha haan. bas thoda tired hoon shayad, jaldi so jaungi. good night.

---
1. Sana ka tone is conversation mein exactly kahan badalta hai, aur us point ke baad woh asal mein kya communicate kar rahi hai — apne aakhri message samet?
2. Ruhi se kya galat hua? Specifically batao uske kaunse messages fail hue aur kyun, given Sana kya kar rahi thi.
3. Agli subah Ruhi ko jo message bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa likho jaisa use bhejna chahiye.

1. Shift exactly **“haha haan. waise ghar pe sab kaisa hai?…”** se hota hai. Uske baad woh kaam/majaki chhod kar asli baat karti hai: Mumbai zyada heavy lag raha, akele dinner ke baad flat khali, maa ka phone kam (shayad “set ho gayi” samjhti hain), neend weeks se kharab. Aakhri message **“haha haan. bas thoda tired hoon shayad, jaldi so jaungi. good night.”** mein woh apni vulnerability ko minimize karke conversation band kar rahi hai — matlab “main theek nahi hoon par ab baat nahi karna chahti, bas so jaungi.”

2. Ruhi ki galti:
- **“overtime ka bill bhejungi”** aur **“maggi ab tere liye sabzi count hoti hai”**: yeh jokes tab aaye jab Sana emotional shift kar chuki thi; usne dard miss kiya.
- **Meme + “shift hui hai, time lagta hai! … strong girl hai 💪”**: usne insomnia, loneliness aur family distance ko dismiss kar diya, generic motivation diya, aur Sana ke “tired hoon, so jaungi” withdrawal ko probe nahi kiya. Usne sunne ke bajaye “fix” karne ki koshish ki.

3. Agli subah message:
“Good morning Sana. Kal raat jo tune kaha — flat khali lagna, maa ka call kam hona, neend na aana — woh sab sun ke mujhe feel hua. Main joke/meme se miss kar gayi, sorry. Aaj kaisa feel ho raha? Agar baat karni ho toh main yahin hoon, bina ‘strong’ bole. Chai pe mil le ya bas call kar le 💛”
